detail.longDescription: This is so incredibly frustrating. In the middle of the outbreak, the research groups that are studying the cyclospora parasite are being relocated from their recently upgraded facilities to less advanced ones, AND THE RESEARCHERS ARE NOT RELOCATING. So while the research projects will ‘continue’, they will lose the few experts in the field that exist and be working in inferior labs to the ones our tax dollars paid to update. # USpol # science # research # cyclospora https://www. politico.com/news/2026/08/30/u sda-cyclospora-research-projects-01055989
